hebrewText: וְ/לִ/בְנ֖/וֹ אֶתֵּ֣ן שֵֽׁבֶט אֶחָ֑ד לְמַ֣עַן הֱיֽוֹת נִ֣יר לְ/דָֽוִיד עַ֠בְדִּ/י כָּֽל הַ/יָּמִ֤ים לְ/פָנַ/י֙ בִּ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם הָ/עִיר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּחַ֣רְתִּי לִ֔/י לָ/שׂ֥וּם שְׁמִ֖/י שָֽׁם

tokens.kjv: [idiom] correction, dart, rod, sceptre, staff, tribe.

tokens.bdb: a lamp (i.e. the burner) or light (literally or figuratively)
David, the youngest son of Jesse

tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).

tokens.bdb: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.

there (transferring to time) then; often thither, or thence
